questions.stem: When is NO work done on an object?

options.text: When a force accelerates the object
When the force and movement are in the same direction
When the force is perpendicular to the direction of movement
When friction slows the object down

questions.explanation: No work is done when the force is perpendicular (at 90 degrees) to the direction of movement. For example, gravity does no work on an object moving horizontally, and the centripetal force does no work on an object in circular motion.
